label: 🐘 Postgres
description: Read or write a PostgreSQL table. The URI is a standard postgresql:// connection string. Reverse-ETL writes use Polars.write_database with append / replace / fail modes.

table.label: Table name
table.help: On read: SELECT * FROM <table>. On write: target table for the output. Supports schema-qualified names.

schema.label: Schema
schema.help: Defaults to 'public'. Ignored if 'table' is already schema-qualified.

query.label: Custom SQL query (read only)
query.help: Used when 'Table name' is empty. Executed verbatim against Postgres. Has no effect on write.

if_exists.label: Write mode (when table exists)
if_exists.help: Reverse-ETL only. 'append' inserts rows; 'replace' drops + recreates; 'fail' aborts if the table exists.
